prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write package solution in solution.go with the function at package scope.
Required API: func MultisetOverlap(left []int, right []int) []int
Behavior: Treat right as a multiset. Scan left in order and retain each value only while an unused equal occurrence remains in right. Preserve left order, do not mutate either input, and return a non-null empty result when there is no overlap.
Visible example: For left [3,1,3,2,3] and right [3,3,2], return [3,3,2].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
package solution
func MultisetOverlap(left,right []int) []int {c:=map[int]int{};for _,x:=range right{c[x]++};out:=[]int{};for _,x:=range left{if c[x]>0{out=append(out,x);c[x]--}};return out}
